_readme: Copy this file (e.g. to setup/my-restaurant.json — files in setup/ other than this example are git-ignored), replace every value, then run: npm run setup:restaurant -- --config setup/my-restaurant.json --dry-run. Never put passwords or keys in this file: the Owner's password is asked for when the setup runs. Logo and photos can be added afterwards from the admin panel (or given here as https:// image URLs). Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored.

restaurant.description: A short paragraph about the restaurant and its event halls, shown on the home page.
restaurant.policyNotes: Outside catering is not permitted. Decorations must be removed by closing time.
restaurant.cancellationPolicy: The advance is refundable up to 30 days before the event.
restaurant._rules: eventTypes: keep "Other" to let customers describe their own event. openingTime/closingTime: both "HH:mm", or both "" for any time. minNoticeDays: 0 allows same-day bookings. maxAdvanceDays: null for no limit.

owner._note: The restaurant owner's login. The password is NOT stored here.
owner.name: Owner Name

catalog._note: Optional starting items; the restaurant can edit or replace them from the admin panel. Each type is only added if the database has none yet.

halls.name: Main Banquet Hall
halls.description: Our largest hall, with a stage and dance floor.

packages.name: Classic Celebration
packages.description: Hall décor, welcome drinks and a standard buffet.
